parsed.internal_thinking: First settlement at 19 gives me access to hexes around 8,9,4: likely high wheat/ore/sheep from H array (W11? O2 S11 etc). Need to complement with brick and wood mainly. Tool results show top nodes are 10 and 12 both with 11 pips, brick6 (good production), sheep, some wood. Node 10 has sheep8 (5pips) + brick6(5) but wood12 is only 1 pip - weak. Node 12 has brick6(5pips), sheep5(4pips), wood3(2pips) - more balanced pips overall. Inspect confirms both available, not blocked by existing settlements (19 mine, 23 ג'מה, 41/43 ג'ימי) or their adjacents. Node 25 gives ore which I partially have but lower pips. Node 10 is adjacent to my first at 19? Neighbors of 10 are 9,11,20; my 19 connects to 20 via road, but node 10 not directly adjacent to 19 so ok per rules (can't place adj to any settlement). Between 10 and 12, 12 is better positioned near ג'ימי's wood area to contest or expand, and avoids the low-pip wood12 hex somewhat. But both similar; go with 12 for slightly better pip distribution and future road towards center. This is second settlement so also get initial resources after. No chat needed as placement is straightforward, memory update for next: ג'ימי on wood, I go for brick/sheep balance.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed second settlement on 12 for brick/sheep/wood balance (11 pips). Complements 19. Watch ג'ימי wood push.
